name: voltkit
table:
| Module | Import | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **root** | `github.com/ubgo/voltkit/...` | the kit's core packages, below |
| `appmeta` | `.../appmeta` | app identity: name, env prefix, directory names, DB location policy |
| `appdir` | `.../appdir` | resolves where state lives — and reports which rung decided |
| `output` | `.../output` | the stable `{schema_version, kind, count, data}` JSON envelope |
| `versioncmd` | `.../versioncmd` | plug-and-play `version` command with build provenance |
| `skillcmd` | `.../skillcmd` | a `skills` subcommand for any CLI: serves the project's published SKILL.md agent skills, always matched to the binary's version |
| `apps/demo` | — | the reference binary built from the kit — installable, not importable |
| `apps/volt` | — | the family tool: `new` · `status` · `ci` · `cover` · `build` · `release` · `gen` · `doctor` · `update` — see its README |
